heading: Repayments to officers or employees
lead: The Secretary, subject to regulations prescribed by the Secretary, is authorized to repay—

tree.heading: Collections recovered
tree.text: To any officer or employee of the United States the full amount of such sums of money as may be recovered against him in any court, for any internal revenue taxes collected by him, with the cost and expense of suit; also

tree.heading: Damages and costs
tree.text: All damages and costs recovered against any officer or employee of the United States in any suit brought against him by reason of anything done in the due performance of his official duty under this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1976—Pub. L. 94–455 struck out “or his delegate” after “Secretary” in provisions preceding par. (1).
